fields.question: What is the purpose of the Nmfaf_3daDataManagement_Deconfigure service operation? [3GPP Release 18]
fields.option 1: To configure the MFAF to map data or analytics received by the MFAF to out-bound notification endpoints
fields.option 2: To configure the MFAF to stop mapping data or analytics received by the MFAF to out-bound notification endpoints
fields.option 3: To supply data or analytics from the MFAF to notification endpoints
fields.option 4: To fetch data or analytics from the MFAF based on fetch instructions
fields.answer: option 2: To configure the MFAF to stop mapping data or analytics received by the MFAF to out-bound notification endpoints
fields.explanation: The Nmfaf_3daDataManagement_Deconfigure service operation is used to stop mapping data or analytics received by the MFAF to one or more out-bound notification endpoints.

fields.question: When can there be two N3 tunnel terminations at the RAN for a PDU Session? [3GPP Release 18]
fields.option 1: When there are multiple PDU Session Ids for the PDU Session
fields.option 2: When the QoS Flows of the PDU Session are split across the two RATs
fields.option 3: When the PDU Session belongs to a specific Network Slice
fields.option 4: When the Master RAN node is congested
fields.option 5: When the Secondary RAN node is congested
fields.answer: option 2: When the QoS Flows of the PDU Session are split across the two RATs
fields.explanation: If the DL User Plane traffic of some QoS Flows of a PDU Session are directed to the Secondary RAN Node while the remaining QoS Flows are directed to the Master RAN Node, there will be two N3 tunnel terminations at the RAN for such PDU Session.
